note: Official Etihad onboard meals and special meals pages. Actual dishes and availability can depend on the flight; dietary and children's meals require advance requests where specified.

chunks.document_title: Etihad onboard food and meal options
chunks.section_path: Fly with Etihad > Onboard services > Meals > Cabin dining
chunks.passage: Onboard food options vary by cabin and flight. In Economy, Etihad offers complimentary Halal meals or snacks and complimentary drinks, including soft drinks, tea, coffee and alcoholic beverages. Business offers à la carte dining, and First offers gourmet dining. The general meals page does not give an exact menu for a particular flight.

chunks.document_title: Etihad special meal and dietary options
chunks.passage: Special food and meal options on Etihad-operated flights include vegetarian, vegan, Hindu, Kosher, diabetic, gluten-intolerant and low-lactose meals, subject to availability and the published meal rules. Request most special meals at least 24 hours before departure; Kosher meals require at least 72 hours. On flights shorter than 2 hours 50 minutes, Etihad accepts special-meal requests only for diabetic, gluten-intolerant or low-lactose meals. Etihad says all meals served are Halal.

chunks.section_path: Fly with Etihad > Onboard services > Meals > Children's meals
chunks.passage: Children's food and meal options are available on Etihad flights longer than 2 hours 50 minutes. Request a children's meal at least 24 hours before departure. Availability depends on the flight and advance request.
